pageChange.when: The user activates a page other than the current one, or the previous or next control.

rules: An item is one page: it shows its number in typography, with tabular figures so that numbers keep their width, centered in a box at least minSize wide and exactly minSize tall, growing with paddingInline on both sides for long numbers, with radius corners. Its accessible name is the number.

The current page uses interaction selected (selected-hover under the pointer): surface and content of the selected item and an inner edge of indicatorThickness in indicatorColor, so that the current page is not conveyed by the tint alone; it is exposed as the current page. Other pages use default, and hover under the pointer.
When focus is true from the keyboard, a focus indicator of focusWidth in focusColor at focusOffset with focusRadius corners is drawn outside the box.
Colors change over motionDuration with easingStandard; no transition under reduced motion.

An ellipsis stands for a run of hidden pages: a horizontal ellipsis in content and typography, centered in a box of minSize. It is not interactive, never focused, and hidden from assistive technology.

Pagination moves through a long list or table split into numbered pages, when the user benefits from knowing the position and jumping to a page. A feed read in order is better served by a Load more Button or by scrolling.

Pagination is exposed as a navigation landmark named by label holding, in a row in source order separated by gap: previous, the page items, next. It is centered in no particular way: it takes the inline size of its content and the application places it.

previous and next are IconButtons of the pagination's size, intent neutral and appearance ghost, named previousLabel and nextLabel, showing a chevron towards the start and the end (mirrored in right-to-left text). previous is disabled on page 1 and next on the last page; disabled, they stay in place.

The items show page 1, the last page, the current page and siblingCount pages on each side of it; a gap of hidden pages becomes an ellipsis, except a gap of a single page, which is shown as that page. The number of items is constant (siblingCount × 2 + 5, or pageCount when smaller), so that previous and next do not move while the user pages.
page is clamped between 1 and pageCount. Activating a page other than the current one, previous or next sets page and emits pageChange; activating the current page does nothing.

When href is set, each page, previous and next are links to href with every {page} replaced by their page number, and activating one navigates and emits pageChange; otherwise they are buttons. A disabled previous or next is never a link.

Every enabled page, previous and next is its own stop in sequential focus in source order; pagination adds no arrow-key navigation. After activation by keyboard, focus stays on the activated control when it remains, and moves to the new current page otherwise.
In forced-colors mode the current page keeps a visible edge in the system highlight color and the focus indicator stays visible.
